original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚三角洲州政府指责NDC集会组织者应对暴力冲突负责
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚三角洲州政府指责在阿萨巴举行的政治游行组织者无视警方建议，未在指定场地举行集会，导致暴力冲突，造成一人死亡、多人受伤。涉事者为支持尼日利亚民主大会党总统候选人彼得·奥比的Obidient/OK运动支持者。政府和警方谴责该事件，并警告各政党在2027年大选前不得从事威胁公共和平的活动。

key_facts.fact: 三角洲州政府指责政治游行组织者无视警方建议，未在指定场地举行集会
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Delta State Government has blamed organisers of a political procession in Asaba on Saturday for a violent clash that left one person dead and several others injured, saying they ignored police advice to hold the rally at a designated venue.

key_facts.fact: 阿萨巴的暴力冲突造成一人死亡、多人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a violent clash that left one person dead and several others injured

key_facts.fact: 涉事者为支持彼得·奥比的Obidient/OK运动支持者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident involving supporters of the Obidient/OK Movement, which was campaigning for the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, Peter Obi

key_facts.fact: 警方呼吁政党及支持者避免道路游行并提前通知警方
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Commissioner of Police, CP Samuel Erale, urged political parties and their supporters to avoid road processions and notify the police ahead of political gatherings

uncertainties: 事件细节目前仅来自单一来源（Punch），尚缺乏交叉验证
冲突具体经过及责任归属尚未获独立确认
